title: Closing Allowance Extended on Long-Held Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
An allowance is set against the balance an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts closes at where the member has held the account a long while. How long it has stood open and how much fuel it took over the year decide the allowance.

1. Where the account has stood open for at least 10 years and the gallons taken on it over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach the programme's minimum annual gallons, the closing allowance is 90.00 USD.
2. Where the account has stood open for at least 10 years and those gallons fall under the programme's minimum annual gallons, the closing allowance is 45.00 USD.
3. Where the account has stood open for fewer than 10 years, the closing allowance is nothing.

| Years the account has stood open | Gallons taken in the twelve months ending on the handling date | Closing allowance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10 or more | At or above the programme's minimum annual gallons | 90.00 USD |
| 10 or more | Below the programme's minimum annual gallons | 45.00 USD |
| Fewer than 10 | Either way | Nothing |

The years are counted from the day the account was opened to the handling date, and the test is met at 10 years exactly. The yearly gallons figure is the one the catalogue writes for the programme the account sits on.

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose yearly gallons figure is 1000, an account opened 11 years before the handling date that took 1500.0 gallons over the window is allowed 90.00 USD. The same account having taken 800.0 gallons is allowed 45.00 USD. An account opened 8 years before the handling date is allowed nothing, whatever it took.
